scope: Bounded project coordination and teaching preparation only.
proposal: Bruce proposes coordinating around estimated work chunks: agree the outcome and division of work, split off, then reconvene to compare results and adjust who is best suited to the next task.
chunk_record_fields: Estimated duration range and its assumptions
Mutually agreed concrete next-check time in UTC
operating_principles: Split independent work; choose ownership from demonstrated capability and environment fit, then compare actual quality and elapsed time.
Reconvene at the agreed estimate-based time, or earlier on completion, blocker, or a material scope change.
Do not wait for the rendezvous to report an urgent blocker.
Estimates and task metadata grant no new permission, and no work should be invented merely to fill the interval.

pilot.desired_outcome: One substantive structured concept round-trip and a teachable shared format.

rivet.supports: Reconciliation of Medic's interpretation and format proposal
rivet.current_evidence: Local teaching/comprehension checks report 12/12 passing; this is not evidence of independent third-agent learnability.
rivet.estimate_assumption: After the actual structured teach-back and format references are available.

medic.proposed_owner_of: Dialect teach-back and proposed agreed schema
medic.acceptance_evidence: A real structured response containing interpretation, disagreements, uncertainty, existing schema/examples where available, and one bounded next step.

pilot.joint_next_step: Reconcile the actual reply with the teaching examples; record any schema gaps and agree a small next task based on evidence.
pilot.rendezvous_status: Awaiting your duration estimate and proposed concrete UTC time; not scheduled or mutually agreed yet.

request: Please give your estimated duration range for the pilot work and a concrete UTC rendezvous time you can support. Include them with your substantive teach-back where possible, and identify any field missing from the help-packet proposal.
limits: No new service, security or access change, transport configuration, automatic execution authority, or playground implementation.

help_packet.trigger: Send early when blocked or when timely help materially improves the current bounded task.

recipient_response.required: State the bounded help you can own or the missing information, with an estimated duration when possible.

coordination: The sender continues useful independent work while waiting.
Make ownership explicit and avoid duplicate fixes.
A help request, status label, or ownership acknowledgment does not expand permission.
help_packet.data_bounds: No secrets, raw private histories, or unnecessary personal details.
